snippet.title: Dino Domino — Pseudo‑Programming x Turn‑Based Puzzle | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Pseudo‑programming meets turn‑based puzzles.

Dino Domino is a pixel‑art puzzle game where you reprogram unit logic—and even the system itself—to solve levels: steal enemy moves, turn traps into healing, and build playful loops.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921050

Solo dev: porridge. Thank you for your support!

#IndieGame #PuzzleGame #TurnBased

伪编程 × 回合制解谜。

在 Dino Chess 中，你可以用“规则编辑/伪编程”改写单位逻辑乃至系统本身：偷敌人招式、把陷阱变治疗、甚至构建可控循环，用反直觉的方式解谜通关。
